alternatives.name: WHALE_EVENT_ENVELOPE_WITH_AGGRESSOR_PROVENANCE
tradeoffs: Generalized whale_event payloads add schema surface but keep disclosure envelopes unchanged.

negative: Unknown aggressor remains unknown; estimated BVC regions must retain quality labels.
positive: order_flow family can surface entitled fixture CVD without weakening disclosure semantics.

decision.summary: Order-flow whale events use whale_event payloads with family order_flow, signed delta, cumulative_delta, aggressor_provenance (known|unknown|inferred), and quality labels. PIT queries exclude events whose available_time exceeds prediction_cutoff.
decision.title: Order-flow whale envelope semantics and aggressor provenance

effectivity.non_authorization_statement: Acceptance authorizes fixture-first order_flow on ADMITTED-CVD-NVDA-ORDERFLOW-001 only. Live trade feeds and order_book families require separate entitlement records.
